Operations.Value: The watchfort exists at the edge of the forest, built into a hillside with thick dark walls and narrow slit-like windows.
A single lantern burns in the main gate of the watchfort.
The path from the forest to the watchfort is clear and leads down a gentle slope.
The forest is ancient, with gnarled trees and roots forming natural barriers.
The edge of the forest reveals open, rolling hills beyond.
The watchfort is located at the bottom of a slope outside the forest.
